title: What Scrolling For 1 Hour Does To Your Brain
sources: Stanford Medicine Neuroscience - Screen Dopamine Adaptation Study
Huberman Lab - Dopamine Receptor Downregulation and Prefrontal Cortex

lines.text: What happens if you scroll your phone right after waking up?
Well, your brain starts the day in a calm alpha-wave state,
but each short video hits you with a 200 percent dopamine spike.
To protect itself from burnout, your brain literally shuts down its dopamine receptors.
This is why everyday tasks like studying or working suddenly feel painful.
So is your motivation broken forever? Nope, that's a myth.
Your brain can reset those receptors within forty-eight hours.
Just wait thirty minutes before touching your phone tomorrow morning,
and watch your natural focus double.
